content: CMMS duplicate detection best practice: on new request, check existing open work orders on same asset/location with similar description; if matched, inform requester of existing tracking number and merge rather than create new. Typical duplicate rate without dedup: 10-20% of backlog (e.g. one broken AHU generates 3-5 separate requests). Root cause of duplicates is often free-text asset entry vs standardized picklists breaking matching logic. Deduplication must be an ongoing process, not one-time cleanup. Closed-loop status communication to reporters reduces duplicate submissions.
